end.parentNote: Yash practised levels of organisation using the heart, leaf, and amoeba, and used the idea that tissues combine to form organs. They correctly identified the heart and a leaf as organs after discussing the difference between an organ and an organ system. The digestive-system question remained incomplete because only the stomach was listed, and the full sequence was not yet consistently ordered. At home, ask Yash to arrange the five levels with one human and one plant example for each suitable level.
